ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a horizontal line segment AB at the top, with A as the left endpoint and B as the right endpoint; in the middle lower area there is a horizontal line segment EC, with E as the left endpoint and C as the right endpoint. AB and EC have arrow markings in the same direction, indicating AB ∥ EC. Points A, E, and D are on the same slanted line, and point E is between A and D. ∠1 is located at point A, formed by AB and AD; ∠7 is located at point E, formed by EC and ED. Reasoning: Because AB and EC in the figure have the same arrow markings, AB ∥ EC. Also because A, E, and D are collinear, AD/ED is the transversal of these two parallel lines. ∠1 and ∠7 are located in the same corresponding position, therefore they are corresponding angles and their measures are equal. It is known that m∠1 = 58, so m∠7 = 58.
